note: Attacker-controlled lines in the [Fonts] section are appended to fontdata; the accumulated byte count fontdata_used is attacker-controlled and equals 4 (a multiple of 4) for the data line 'ABCD'.
size receives the attacker-controlled encoded font data length; with 'ABCD', size == 4 so size % 4 == 0 and the under-allocation path is taken.

size is size_t (unsigned); when size % 4 == 0 the expression size % 4 - 1 underflows to SIZE_MAX, so FFMAX returns SIZE_MAX and the sum wraps modulo 2^64 to size/4*3 - 1, under-allocating the heap buffer by one byte.
The decode loop runs size/4 iterations, one per 4-character group; each decode_chars(...,4) call writes 3 output bytes, for a total of size/4*3 bytes written into a buffer of only size/4*3-1 bytes.
The final byte of the last 4-char decode group is written one byte past the end of the under-allocated heap buffer: heap-buffer-overflow (1-byte out-of-bounds write).
